name: Accessibility Monitor v2 — RUN (paste your Anthropic key in the Claude node)

nodes.name: Manual Trigger
nodes.notes: Kicks off the workflow. Also has a Schedule Trigger set to run weekly (Sunday 02:00 UTC). Accepts optional domain input via webhook for on-demand single-domain scans.

nodes.name: Set Scan Config
nodes.notes: NEW in v2: Centralised config node. Sets domain, scan_id (timestamped), and pulls previous scan_id from storage for diff comparison.

nodes.name: Load Axe-core Rules (Reference)
nodes.notes: Loads the 105 axe-core rule definitions collected in Assignment 3 CSV as a reference lookup. Used by the AI Analysis node to enrich violation data with rule descriptions and WCAG mappings before sending to Claude.

nodes.name: Load WCAG Criteria (Reference)
nodes.notes: Loads the 78 WCAG 2.1 success criteria as reference data. Used to enrich Claude prompts with the full criterion text (not just the ID), making fix suggestions significantly more accurate.

nodes.name: Crawl + Audit (Playwright + axe-core)
nodes.notes: In production: calls crawl-and-audit.js via Execute Command node (Playwright + axe-core v4.10). For Assignment 4 demo: returns realistic violation data in exact axe-core output format. Returns 8 violations across 5 pages.

nodes.name: Diff Engine — New vs Resolved
nodes.notes: NEW in v2: Diff engine keyed on a STABLE violation key (rule_id|selector|page), so persisting violations are detected correctly instead of re-billed every week. Classifies each as NEW, PERSISTING, or RESOLVED; only NEW go to Claude. On this scan: 7 new, 1 persisting (link-name on /about), 2 resolved. Severity-weighted score = 62/100 (was 70, delta -8).

nodes.name: Filter — Critical/Serious for Claude
nodes.notes: NEW in v2: Smart filtering — only critical and serious new violations go to Claude API. Moderate/minor get rule-based suggestions. This reduces API cost by ~30% while maintaining quality on high-priority issues.

nodes.name: Claude AI — Generate Fix Suggestions
nodes.notes: NEW in v2: Core AI intelligence node. Calls claude-sonnet-4-6 with each critical/serious violation. Structured system prompt ensures consistent JSON output. Error handling: continueRegularOutput on failure, 30s timeout, max 3 retries via error workflow.

nodes.name: Parse AI Responses + Merge
nodes.notes: NEW in v2: Parses Claude JSON responses with error handling. Falls back to rule-based suggestion if Claude returns malformed JSON. Merges AI suggestions with violation metadata.

// Node 10: Generate HTML Report — the human-readable output // Assembles all violation data + AI suggestions into a complete HTML accessibility report const violations = $('Parse AI Responses + Merge').all().map(i => i.json); const diffResult = $('Diff Engine — New vs Resolved').first().json; const severityColor = { critical: '#E55A3C', serious: '#E8920A', moderate: '#6B5CE7', minor: '#0EA5A0' }; const severityBg = { critical: '#FDEAE5', serious: '#FEF3DC', moderate: '#EEE9FF', minor: '#D4F7F5' }; const violationCards = violations.map(v => { const ai = v.ai_suggestion || {}; const color = severityColor[v.impact] || '#888'; const bg = severityBg[v.impact] || '#F7F6F3'; return `
${v.impact}
${v.description || v.rule_id} ● NEW
Rule: ${v.rule_id} · WCAG ${v.wcag_criterion} · ${v.page_url}
What's wrong

${ai.plain_english || 'See rule documentation.'}

Who is affected

${ai.impact_statement || 'May affect assistive technology users.'}

Affected element
${v.selector}
✦ ${v.ai_generated ? 'Claude AI' : 'Rule-Based'} Fix Suggestion

${ai.code_fix || 'See WCAG documentation.'}

⏱ ${ai.estimated_time || '?'} · Risk: ${ai.risk_level || 'Unknown'}

`; }).join(''); const html = ` Accessibility Report — ${diffResult.domain} — ${diffResult.scan_date}
🤖 AI-Generated by Accessibility Monitor · Madison Agent
Accessibility Audit Report
Powered by axe-core 4.10 + Claude claude-sonnet-4-6
Domain
${diffResult.domain}
Scan Date
${diffResult.scan_date}
Scan ID
${diffResult.scan_id}
Score
${diffResult.current_score}/100 (${diffResult.score_delta > 0 ? '+' : ''}${diffResult.score_delta} from last week)
🆕 ${diffResult.new_count} New Violations · ${diffResult.resolved_count} Resolved · ${diffResult.persisting_count} Persisting
${violationCards}
✦ AI-Powered by Claude claude-sonnet-4-6

${diffResult.new_count} new violations detected this week. Score: ${diffResult.current_score}/100 (${diffResult.score_delta > 0 ? '+' : ''}${diffResult.score_delta} change). Fix the ${violations.filter(v => v.impact === 'critical').length} critical violations first — they have the highest legal and user impact.

Generated by Accessibility Monitor · ${diffResult.scan_id} · ${diffResult.scan_date}
Built with n8n + Claude claude-sonnet-4-6 + axe-core 4.10
`; return [{ json: { html_report: html, filename: `accessibility_report_${diffResult.domain}_${diffResult.scan_date}.html`, scan_id: diffResult.scan_id } }];

nodes.name: Generate HTML Report
nodes.notes: NEW in v2: Assembles all violation data + Claude AI suggestions into a complete, human-readable HTML report. This IS the usable output — a non-technical person can open it and immediately understand the issues and how to fix them.

nodes.name: Save HTML Report
nodes.notes: Saves the HTML report to ~/accessibility-monitor/reports/ directory. Filename: accessibility_report_[domain]_[date].html. This is the primary deliverable — a human-readable accessibility audit report.

parameters.name: body

nodes.name: Send Email Digest (SendGrid)
nodes.notes: NEW in v2: Sends the complete HTML report as an email digest to the registered team. Subject line includes new violation count. Uses SendGrid API (credentials stored in n8n Credentials manager — NOT in this JSON).

nodes.name: Save Violations CSV
nodes.notes: Secondary output: saves all violations with AI suggestions as a CSV for data analysis and tracking. Columns include all violation fields plus ai_suggestion JSON column.

nodes.name: Write Error Log
nodes.notes: Error handler: logs pipeline failures with timestamp and error message. Triggered by n8n's error workflow feature. Does not overwrite successful output files.
